results.answer:
Based on your waist measurement of 70 cm, size **M** is the match (M waist = 70 cm) [1].

Your bust and hip measurements matter too. Size M is designed for a bust of 88 cm and hips of 96 cm [1]. If either of those falls between two sizes, we recommend the larger size [1].

If your measurements don't fit neatly into one size, any dress can be custom tailored to your exact measurements. This costs an extra 1,500 MKD and adds 7 working days to delivery [1].

results.answer:
Delivery to Kosovo normally takes 4 to 6 working days [1]. Custom tailoring adds 7 working days to the delivery time [3][4]. So your tailored dress should arrive in about **11 to 13 working days**.

Some other details that may help:
- Orders placed after 14:00 are shipped the next working day [2].
- You will get a tracking number by email on the day your order ships [2].

The sources don't say whether the 7 tailoring days are counted before shipping or from the order date, so I can't give an exact date.
